items.title: What State Street Financial Sel Sector SPDR (XLF) Bought: Berkshire Leads on Nov. 24
items.summary: The fund added $266.5 million across all 76 holdings on Tuesday, led by a $36.3 million increase in Berkshire Hathaway.

items.title: iShares S&P 500 Value ETF (IVE) Buys $31.4 Million More Apple on Nov. 24
items.summary: The $49.63 billion fund added to 429 positions and sold nothing, with Apple, Amazon and Exxon Mobil its largest purchases.
